tool_description: This tool performs skull stripping on T1-weighted MRIs across the lifespan using atlas-guided priors and deep learning. It selects age-appropriate brain atlases based on the provided subject age and outputs brain masks for input MRIs.

pretrained_dir.description: Path to the directory containing the pre-trained model (checkpoint downloaded here: https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/3f9o9sgls4e88jved8ooo/h?rlkey=h46zb5ulwbacrbh8vtsjwygn0&e=1&dl=0).

input_path.description: Path to the folder containing input T1-weighted MRIs (nifty format).

output_path.description: Directory where output brain masks will be saved.

age_in_month.description: Age of the subject in months (used to select the best-fitting brain atlas).

brain_mask.description: Path to the generated skull-stripped brain mask in the output directory.

model_requirements.checkpoint: Download pre-trained model from https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/3f9o9sgls4e88jved8ooo/h?rlkey=h46zb5ulwbacrbh8vtsjwygn0&dl=0 and place it under ./Model/

citation: @article{wang2025lifespan, title={A lifespan-generalizable skull-stripping model for magnetic resonance images that leverages prior knowledge from brain atlases}, author={Wang, Limei et al.}, journal={Nature Biomedical Engineering}, volume={9}, pages={700--715}, year={2025}, doi={https://doi.org/10.1038/s41551-024-01337-w}}
